top:
STRICT VERTICAL TOP-DOWN ORTHOGRAPHIC modeling SITE PLAN. Camera at zenith looking straight DOWN, no perspective tilt, no cliff sides or vertical facades. ONE high-quality stylized 3D terrain image on PALE NEUTRAL GREY background with whole footprint and12%margin. Image1 is the NEW CLOSED technical road plan: it OVERRIDES the old road in image2. Image2 is the SAME WORLD draft, preserve its biome, land shape, quality and material character while replacing its open road with the NEW winding closed route and adding the specified buildings. Tree crowns/roofs seen from above, no trunks or cliffs. Ignore schematic symbols/colors/dots. Render beautiful readable terrain materials and architecture, not flat diagram.
Physical route MUST follow the NEW closed guide: a long SERPENTINE CIRCUIT passing through the INTERIOR with many alternating smooth bends, then a return corridor JOINING the start tangentially. One continuous repeatable road, NO DEAD ENDS and NO ordinary round perimeter racetrack. Keep the winding interior parts dominant. No same-level intersections, shortcuts, disconnected segments or sharp junction. Reserve generous clear shoulders on both sides for later musical tiles. No labels, marker dots, arrows, compass, UI, characters or glowing tile chain.
TRIPO GEOMETRY: OPEN RAVINES and visible cuttings. NO enclosed caves or long tunnels, no dark tunnel mouth. Only a very SHORT thick natural stone ARCH like a small stone bridge, open to daylight on BOTH sides, with clearly visible road continuing through; roof length no more than road width. Broad flat bridge decks with smooth bank connections. No stairs, house entrances, machines or vegetation across the road.
Add the specified courier-world buildings OUTSIDE road shoulders on broad raised pads. Rounded functional doors, chunky brass/copper radio vents, short sturdy antennas and visible simple mechanisms match the courier characters. Buildings use each world's OWN materials/palette; do not recolor all worlds cream/mint. Keep main terrain silhouette, biome landmarks and distinct colors from draft. Avoid huge central tower surrounded by a circle. Few large readable structures and coherent landscape, not tiny crowded scatter.

WORLD: Солнечные поля
PALETTE: Golden yellow fields, fresh light green grass, barn red, rich brown soil, muted sky-blue fountain water and warm tan earth. No dark cypresses or white domes.
TERRAIN: A wide asymmetric farm plateau with shallow diagonal agricultural terraces and rounded loess cliffs with thick grass-root edges. Open fields occupy much more area than buildings.
LANDSCAPE: One small off-center red timber barn, two chunky sunflower field patches, a low broad stone fountain, a shallow duckless pond and a few apple trees. Large simple crop masses rather than thousands of tiny flowers.
COURIER ARCHITECTURE: Keep SOUTHEAST red barn, make it a courier/radio workshop with one chunky brass vent and short antenna. Add a low red-timber radio home on NORTHWEST wheat terrace and a squat wooden windmill with brass hub on outer WEST/SOUTHWEST field shoulder. Fountain/pond and sunflower masses remain. Three readable silhouettes, not a central tower.
ROAD MATERIAL: Broad ochre farm lane with gentle wheel-worn relief and short brick-paved courtyard segment; no stairs or continuous circular curb.
ART DIRECTION: Sunny stylized farmland with broad friendly forms, matte painted timber and open readable terrain.
Exactly ONE top view; no collage or extra panels.
